newsitem.title: DUBAI: At least 800 dead in Iran quake - official agency.
newsitem.headline: At least 800 dead in Iran quake - official agency.

text.p: At least 800 people were killed and 5,000 injured on Saturday when a powerful earthquake struck eastern Iran, the official news agency IRNA said.
It quoted a local official in the town of Qaen near the quake's epicentre as saying 80 of the region's 150 villages suffered 80 percent destruction and the others were heavily damaged.
The official said the injured were being rushed to hospitals in five nearby towns and cities, the agency said.
He said the area under his jurisdiction, which was struck by the earthquake measuring 7.1. on the Richter scale, had a population of more than 40,000.
Mashhad, Iran's second largest city with a population of about two million, was jolted by the quake, which was felt as far as 800 km (500 miles) away.
The quake zone is significantly less densely populated than an area near the Caspian Sea where 35,000 people were killed by an earthquake measuring 7.3 in 1990.
